api_ca_cert.description: The volt API CA Cert for api operations.

api_cert.description: The volt API cert for api operations.

api_key.description: The volt API key for api operations.

tenant.description: The tenant values, used only when vesenv is set.

timeout.description: The Volt API call timeout value, by default its 20s

vesenv.description: The vesenv flag for itnernal use .

burst.description: The maximum burst size for requests. Allows short bursts up to this many requests before rate limiting applies. Minimum value: 1.

rate.description: The maximum number of requests per minute. This value will be converted to requests per second internally (rate/60). Must be greater than 0. Example: rate=60 allows 1 request per second, rate=0.5 allows 1 request every 2 minutes.

block.description: The F5XC API configuration block for API rate limiting.
